text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: node-57 reporting repeated container restarts (OOM) for model gpt-large-window-v2. 4 restarts in 2m. Paging @oncall-lee

oncall-lee: ack — joining. will grab logs and call out SRE.

kai: dmesg shows repeated CUDA OOMs (error 700) + kernel messages about GPU allocation failures. stacktrace snippet in /var/log/runtime/gpu.log. seeing big KV-cache growth during those requests.

ops-maria: telemetry: spikes correlate with large-window requests from a handful of customers (heavy attachment + long conversation). suggest cordon node-57 and reroute to fallback pool. can also enable model fallback to quantized variant to reduce mem.

oncall-lee: running cordon/drain now — posting commands:
```bash
kubectl cordon node-57
kubectl drain node-57 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
rtp route update --exclude-node node-57
```

sre-jordan: noted. while draining, let's flip runtime KV-trim mode to aggressive on the pool to limit prefix growth (hotfix). pushing config to dedicated-cold-std pool as immediate mitigation.

kai: applied kv_trim=aggressive on pool, restarted runtime on node-57 processes. container still crashed once during restart sequence (total 6 restarts).

incident-bot: Update: node-57 container restarts now 6 in last 6m. Traffic shifted: 92% to fallback pool, 8% still hitting node-57 (drain in progress).

support-ash: customer impact: several customers noticed streaming drops and 502s on the long-window beta. CS engaged; preparing short status update for affected tenants.

oncall-lee: mitigation results: after traffic shift + fallback model + rate-limiter (per-request max_context = 32k) we see restart rate drop ~80% and error rate for long-window calls down ~70%. continuing monitoring.

support-ash: draft status for customers: "We've mitigated an issue causing GPU memory exhaustion for very large-window requests by shifting traffic to fallback pools and applying runtime memory-trimming. Some requests may be truncated; no customer data loss. Full investigation underway; update in 4 hours."

sre-jordan: collecting kernel dumps and NV driver logs from node-57. small cuda stack snippet: 
```
E GPU0 CudaDriver: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
E GPU0 Trace: 0x7fa1b2c4 -> 0x7fa1b9d0 -> 0x400ef2
```

kai: opening internal ticket RN-2026-230 to track root cause (possible KV-cache growth + allocator fragmentation + specific driver path). tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.

oncall-lee: handoff: I'll be handing pager to @sre-jordan in 2h. current state in notes: node-57 cordoned, traffic rerouted, fallback model active, support status drafted, kernel dumps collected.

sre-jordan: taking handoff. will run deeper tracing overnight and coordinate postmortem. if restarts recur, we'll isolate node and repro with synthetic large-window load in staging.

support-ash: prepping a short customer-facing bulletin now.

oncall-lee: thanks team — leaving channel. :thumbsup:

sre-jordan: :rotating_light: continuing monitoring, will update on any regressions.
